projects.title: MechaTank
projects.description:
For Spring 2012 at Rice, I took the course: Advanced Computer Game Creation. In this course, 3 computer science students and 1 visual art student will team up to design and implement an action PC game with multiplayer feature for playing over the Internet . The game engine was built from scratch using OpenGL API and C++. 
- Open Source library used: Assimp for mesh loading, CML for math, Network portion of Boost library for multiplayer over LAN/ Internet.
- Application of navigation mesh technique for maneuver and path finding: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ggZ2tp60MbU

projects.title: Lightweight Programmable Graphics Engine
projects.description:
Implementation of a graphics engine from scratch using programmable pipeline openGL 3.3 and GLSL. Features: Environment mapping, Gaussian blur, Deferred shading, Normal Mapping, Parallax occlusion mapping, Screen Space Ambient Occlusion(SSAO), Gesner Wave simulation, Fire simulation, key frame animation.
 * Basic OpenGL/GLSL demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=48oJ9RZR1EI
 * Deferred Lighting demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gI9Hb3CxDPM
 * Screen Space Ambient Occlusion demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bpREN9R6xzA
